meaning: Retained real CLI assertions, each launched once in a fresh owned saved fixture. Shared model declarations do not qualify this native CLI boundary.

cases.title: S10 CWG skeleton batch runs in the default atomic mode
S10 explicit atomic:false preserves legacy stop-after-error semantics
S6 wrong/absent document is rejected with no wrong-target mutation
S6 active open command: atomic batch is refused without mutating the document
S7 transport timeout stays unknown with no replay and no second mutation
S8 pre-existing run.lock blocks a mutating batch (queue/conflict)
S8 same runId run twice is refused (no mix, no replay)
S9 external-effect operations are rejected before any mutation
S1 default success (no atomic): committed with real geometry, one native transaction
S2 error after mutation (no atomic): abort restores the exact baseline
S2 explicit atomic:true behaves identically to the default
S3 partial handler (before-ref-publish): abort leaves no orphan object
S4 edit existing model (parameter + name) before error is restored
S4 unsupported edit (external-effect) is rejected preflight before mutation
S5 final validation failure aborts the whole batch
S4 transform edit (occurrence move) before error is restored
S4 material edit (assign) before error is restored
